tags.name: provider_settings
tags.description: Schema-driven read/write of provider configuration for the settings pages. Both the admin and the personal page render whatever LLMProviderInterface::getSettingsSchema() describes, so this controller never names a provider or a config key — adding a provider requires no change here. The admin/user split is enforced twice over: the admin routes carry no #[NoAdminRequired] (so Nextcloud requires an admin), and ProviderSettingsService::writeUser() additionally drops any field whose scope is not user-writable. That second check is what keeps endpoint URLs — which decide where the server sends outbound requests — out of reach of the personal page even if a route were ever mis-annotated.
